Powell on the wire. From 2020 to 2021, Dr. Miran served as senior adviser for economic policy at the U.S. Department of the Treasury.

He worked in financial markets for a decade before joining the Treasury.

Prior to his appointment to the Board, Dr. Miran served as chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers under President Donald J.

Trump.

He previously worked as a senior strategist at Hudson Bay Capital Management and a senior fellow at the Manhattan Institute for Policy Research.

Dr. Miran received a B.A. in economics, philosophy, and mathematics from Boston University.

He earned a Ph.D. in economics from Harvard University.
